lede: BYU carries the stronger underlying team rating — +4.5 against +2.2, a 2.4-point separation on a neutral field before home advantage, travel or rest.
EdgeDesk makes it TCU +4.8 before any sportsbook number is consulted, with BYU winning 62% of simulations.

Data confidence on this matchup is 84% — high by this board’s standards, so the margin is the strongest part of the read.
